key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate, lanceolate to oblong-lanceolate, entire to toothed/lobed.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Large solitary lavender-pink heads made only of disc florets; outer florets enlarged and showy.

key_traits.label: Phyllaries
key_traits.text: Broadly overlapping, papery/fringed bracts create the distinctive basket appearance.
